content: Guru is the shipping proof that verification-status affordances get used. Three states per card: Verified (green check, reviewed and confirmed accurate), Unverified (gray, potentially outdated), None (no badge, never reviewed). Verification is assigned to a named SME owner with an expiration/frequency - default 1 month, custom up to 10 years, or 'Does not expire' for evergreen. Re-verification can be done inline from Slack. Critically, Guru's AI Knowledge Agents use verified status as a retrieval trust signal: overdue cards get deprioritized or flagged in answers, verified cards get preferentially surfaced. So verification is not decorative metadata - it feeds ranking.
